messages:
devon: :rotating_light: Heads-up — we're seeing a P99 cold-start latency spike on hosted small models in us-east-1. Affects ~5% of requests; P95 unchanged. Investigating. Incident doc: https://rwd-internal/status/3078001111
ops-oncall: Ack. I can see ingestion of new pods taking longer to become Ready. Pull time + init scripts look elevated.
mira: Noticed EBS attach times spiking for some hosts, plus kubelet logs show backoff on image pull. Could be underlying host IO pressure.
carlos: Oncall: can we temporary raise warm-pool target for these pools so requests go to warmed containers? I can push a policy change.
ops-oncall: Trying cold-start mitigation: bumping min_replicas for model-hosting-small in us-east-1 to 6 -> 12 and increasing prefetch concurrency. Will monitor.
infra-bot: deploybot: Starting rollout of host-warmup-policy v2 (patch) to us-east-1. CID: deploy-20260323-7321.
sre-bot: Alert correlation: correlates with recent node image update 2026-03-23T01:10Z; 14 nodes relaunched across pool-3-us-east-1. Possible regression in init hooks.
anna-product: Any customer-facing impact? Which customers hit errors or just latency?
devon: No 5xx spikes observed, only elevated tail latency. Customer-impact likely UX slowness (first token delay). We'll update status page if anything worsens.
carlos: If warm-pool bump doesn't reduce tail, plan B: roll back init hook 1.4 -> 1.3 and reimage a subset of nodes. Preparing rollback playbook.
ops-oncall: Warm-pool change shows improvement after ~3m. P99 dropped from ~1.4s to ~380ms on small models in us-east-1. Continuing to watch.
mira: Collecting attach + pull timings to attach to postmortem. Saving logs: /var/log/host-init/attach.log and cluster traces: https://rwd-internal/traces/3078001111
carlos: I'll hold rollback but ready if we regress. Thanks for quick action.
devon: TL;DR: Cold-start P99 spike from node init/image attach after node rollout. Mitigated by increasing warm pool and prefetch. Monitoring for stabilization. Will file postmortem and customer note if persists.
ops-oncall: Closing incident thread for now. Will reopen if P99 creeps back. :white_check_mark:
